ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution (>90% dark) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized scars and tip-localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey to black contiguous surface area. High-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped to the inner-right lobe and the lower-center region near the notch. High-texture brownish-grey clusters occupy the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a narrow vertex; estimated pixel depth of approximately 10% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits a higher frequency of low-amplitude peaks (5-10 pixels) compared to the more subtly varied left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to a sharp, tapered convex sweep at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-texture, multi-tonal clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Minor white circular clusters visible in the axial region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) detected. Notable diagonal scratches on the inner right lobe and a shorter horizontal scratch on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) on the ventral surface and heavy bio-fouling/barnacle encrustation on the distal lobe margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant protrusion of textured barnacle masses at the lobe tips altering the expected geometric perimeter.
